tables.formatSpec: (ooxml, embedded labels, table is [★ Schema & Guide])

tables.selectStatement:
LOAD [DateKey] AS [DateKey],
	[Date] AS [Date],
	[Day] AS [Day],
	[Month] AS [Month],
	[MonthName] AS [MonthName],
	[Quarter] AS [Quarter],
	[Year] AS [Year],
	[WeekNumber] AS [WeekNumber],
	[DayOfWeek] AS [DayOfWeek],
	[IsWeekend] AS [IsWeekend],
	[HalfYear] AS [HalfYear]
FROM [lib://Downloads/Demo_CRM_Star_Schema.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Dim_Date);

LOAD [HCP_ID] AS [HCP_ID],
	[HCP_Name] AS [HCP_Name],
	[Specialty] AS [Specialty],
	[City] AS [City],
	[State] AS [State],
	[Region] AS [Region],
	[Tier] AS [Tier],
	[Segment] AS [Segment],
	[Prescriber_Decile] AS [Prescriber_Decile],
	[NPI_Number] AS [NPI_Number],
	[Account_Type] AS [Account_Type]
FROM [lib://Downloads/Demo_CRM_Star_Schema.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Dim_HCP);

LOAD [Product_ID] AS [Product_ID],
	[Product_Name] AS [Product_Name],
	[Molecule] AS [Molecule],
	[Category] AS [Category],
	[Therapeutic_Area] AS [Therapeutic_Area],
	[Strength] AS [Strength],
	[Unit_Price_USD] AS [Unit_Price_USD]
FROM [lib://Downloads/Demo_CRM_Star_Schema.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Dim_Product);

LOAD [Territory_ID] AS [Territory_ID],
	[Territory_Name] AS [Territory_Name],
	[Region] AS [Region],
	[District] AS [District],
	[Rep_ID] AS [Rep_ID],
	[Rep_Name] AS [Rep_Name],
	[Rep_Manager] AS [Rep_Manager],
	[Annual_Goal_USD] AS [Annual_Goal_USD]
FROM [lib://Downloads/Demo_CRM_Star_Schema.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Dim_Territory);

LOAD [Fact_ID] AS [Fact_ID],
	[DateKey] AS [DateKey],
	[HCP_ID] AS [HCP_ID],
	[Product_ID] AS [Product_ID],
	[Territory_ID] AS [Territory_ID],
	[Rep_ID] AS [Rep_ID],
	[Visit_Type] AS [Visit_Type],
	[Call_Status] AS [Call_Status],
	[Detail_Position] AS [Detail_Position],
	[Samples_Dropped] AS [Samples_Dropped],
	[NRx_Units] AS [NRx_Units],
	[TRx_Units] AS [TRx_Units],
	[Sales_USD] AS [Sales_USD],
	[Goal_Flag] AS [Goal_Flag],
	[Call_Duration_Min] AS [Call_Duration_Min],
	[Follow_Up_Flag] AS [Follow_Up_Flag]
FROM [lib://Downloads/Demo_CRM_Star_Schema.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Fact_CRM);
